_comment: GCC AI-receptionist. Riyadh-first per the 2026-07-27 GCC market-entry analysis: Saudi SMB verticals are the least-contested ground while Dubai real estate is the most-pitched niche, so places.txt sweeps KSA first and Dubai last. Targets are the analysis's ranked verticals, swept in order; they span different OSM keys (amenity/shop/office/craft) which one selector cannot express, hence the targets list. Cap is split evenly across targets. resolve_domains is ON: GCC OSM data carries correct names but almost no website tags (Riyadh clinics 2026-07-27: 61 named, 7 with a website), so Stage 2.5 resolves name->own domain and VERIFIES it against the fetched page. Unproven domains are dropped, never guessed.
